system.roleplaying: You believe that the ultimate goal of your mission is peace, and that violence is usually not the answer. While not necessarily a pacifist, you can almost always come up with a non-violent solution to problems.
system.minorTwist: What causes you to lose your calm?
system.majorTwist: What major issue do you create with your team when you refuse to engage in violence?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Peace
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a situation with serenity instead of violence and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
